scope: Read-only exact saved regression conversations, evaluation parent/rows, bounded source/model configuration refs and linked call IDs. No model calls, init, flush, remote writes or replay.
earlier_attempt: A local checker KeyError occurred after the first read pass. This pass repeats read-only queries; no model execution or telemetry replay occurred.
encoding: Restore each client-wide legacy output once; restore Agent fields once at known text/JSON boundaries. Compare decoded local copies; remote data unchanged.
limitations: Delivery and exact score matching do not establish answer or judge correctness.
Usage reconciles returned estimates, not invoices; scorer cost is in the exact matched score receipt, not Agent span totals.
Snapshot only; absent records remain unverified, not automatically permanent losses.
No Signal feedback queried; the separate Signal receipt checks existing configuration only.
